title: English Practice Quiz 0230
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: She ___ to work every day.
questions.explanation: With he, she or it in the present simple, add -s or -es to most verbs.

questions.question: This is the woman ___ helped me.
She ___ the report before the manager arrived.
questions.explanation: Use the past perfect for an action completed before another past action.

questions.question: Choose the opposite of 'polite'.
questions.explanation: Rude is the opposite of polite.

questions.question: What is the meaning of 'available'?
options: ready or able to be used
questions.explanation: Available means ready for use or accessible.

questions.question: The meeting starts ___ 9 a.m.
questions.explanation: Use at for a specific clock time.

questions.question: When I was five, I ___ swim.
Choose the correct sentence.
questions.explanation: Use there are with plural nouns.

questions.question: Which word has a silent 'k'?
questions.explanation: The k in know is silent.

questions.question: Read: 'The meeting was cancelled because the manager was ill.' Why was it cancelled?
questions.explanation: The reason is explicitly stated: the manager was ill.
